    c = sys.stdin.read(1)

            sign = 1
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)

def mod_pow(base, exp, P):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = res * base % P
        base = base * base % P
        exp >>= 1
    return res

    if x < y or y < 0:

    return fact[x] * inv_fact[y] % P * inv_fact[x - y] % P

def sum_series(x):
